questions.question: What were the great pyramids of Giza built as?
questions.explanation: They housed the burials of pharaohs.

questions.question: Who is the king of the gods in Greek mythology?
questions.explanation: Zeus rules the Olympians from the sky.

questions.question: What creature is half man and half bull in Greek myth?
questions.explanation: The Minotaur had a bull's head on a man's body.

questions.question: Which Norse god wields the hammer Mjölnir?
questions.explanation: Thor is the god of thunder.

questions.question: Which Egyptian god of the afterlife was killed by his brother Set?
questions.explanation: Osiris became ruler of the dead.

questions.question: Which French author published Cinderella, Puss in Boots and Sleeping Beauty in his 1697 collection of tales?
questions.explanation: Perrault's Histoires ou contes du temps passé appeared in 1697 with the subtitle Mother Goose Tales.

questions.question: According to Homeric tradition, who devised the wooden horse used to enter Troy?
questions.explanation: The Odyssey credits Odysseus with the trick.

questions.question: Which religion's oldest sacred texts are the Vedas?
questions.explanation: The Vedas are the oldest scriptures of Hinduism.

questions.question: Which sacred text of Judaism is also the first five books of the Hebrew Bible?
questions.explanation: The Torah, also called the Pentateuch, contains the first five books.

questions.question: In the Prague legend, which rabbi is said to have created the golem?
questions.explanation: The Maharal of Prague is the rabbi of the legend.

questions.question: Which was the last of the twelve labours of Heracles in the standard ordering?
questions.explanation: The twelfth labour took him to the underworld to bring back its guard dog.

questions.question: Which Titan was condemned to hold up the sky?
questions.explanation: Atlas was punished by Zeus after the Titans lost their war.

questions.question: Which giant wolf is foretold to kill Odin at Ragnarök?
questions.explanation: Fenrir swallows Odin and is then killed by his son Víðarr.

questions.question: Which title, meaning the awakened one, is given to Siddhartha Gautama?
questions.explanation: Buddha comes from the Sanskrit for awakened.
